copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在梳理复杂系统的模块依赖并想降低耦合风险
copy.tagline_en: Analyze module dependencies and prioritize refactoring by risk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are untangling module dependencies in a complex system to reduce coupling risk

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析各功能切片之间的依赖关系，生成依赖矩阵、计算风险得分，并推荐安全的开发顺序。
howto.when: 当你说“使用 dependency-mapping 技能”，或者在 Ask 模式的 Phase 2（CONVERGE）阶段、规划多个切片时触发。

say.text: 分析这三个切片的依赖关系
say.note: Claude 会构建 DSM 矩阵并给出评分。

say.text: 计算每个切片的风险得分
say.note: Claude 会依据依赖数、复用程度等计算。

say.text: 列出阻塞其他切片的项
say.note: Claude 会标记高扇入的阻塞切片。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will analyze dependencies between implementation slices, build a DSM matrix, calculate risk scores, and recommend a safe implementation order.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "use dependency-mapping skill", during Ask mode Phase 2 (CONVERGE), or when planning multi-slice features.

say_en.note: Claude will build a DSM matrix and score them.

say_en.text: Calculate risk scores for each slice
say_en.note: Claude uses dependency count, leverage, etc.
